foundation.method: Adapted from the pinned PX4 implementation under the recorded independent-code policy. The original source files carry GPL-2.0-only identifiers; destination files in this candidate carry MIT identifiers within the approved scope below.

source_files.moved_scope: Error values and Result<T>/Result<void> declarations and behavior.
source_files.excluded_scope: No error/result API behavior was excluded. Include path, namespace, header guard, and SPDX line were adapted.

source_files.moved_scope: LogLevel, LogRecord, LogSink, and Logger declarations.
source_files.excluded_scope: No logging API behavior was excluded. Include path, namespace, header guard, and SPDX line were adapted; no product-specific logger backend was added.

source_files.moved_scope: The neutral ByteView, MutableByteView, Timeout, StreamConfig, StreamEventKind, StreamEvent, BulkReadObservation, and Transport declarations from original lines 19-77.
source_files.excluded_scope: The six device constants at original lines 12-17 (transfer limits and command/TS endpoint values) were excluded.

source_files.moved_scope: Mock operation/outcome types, expectation API, and transport override declarations.
source_files.excluded_scope: The default constructor and implicit product limits/endpoint selection were replaced by explicit MockTransportPolicy input. No real device transport or product-specific endpoint constants were included.

source_files.moved_scope: The error_string mapping for the Error values.
source_files.excluded_scope: No error mapping behavior was excluded. Include path and namespace were adapted; unrelated product code was not included.

source_files.moved_scope: Logger threshold and sink behavior, plus log-level string mapping.
source_files.excluded_scope: No logging behavior was excluded. Include path and namespace were adapted; no product-specific logger backend was included.

source_files.moved_scope: Mock expectation FIFO, validation, result, partial-transfer, stream, and observation behavior.
source_files.excluded_scope: Product transfer limits and TS endpoint selection were replaced by the explicit MockTransportPolicy fields. No real USB/device behavior or product-specific transport code was included.

receiver.method: Adapted from the pinned PX4 TunerService under the recorded independent-code policy, after the backend type seam required by its candidate classification. Only the expressions listed under moved_scope are in the destinations; the original files remain GPL-2.0-only in the product, which keeps them as a facade over this engine.
authority: agent-workspace branch research/followup-extraction-candidates.json (classification needs_backend_type_seam for both source files)

source_files.moved_scope: Operation set of the backend seam at original lines 41-115 without default bodies; the nonce, lease/attachment ID, and time seams (118-144); the acquire result, attachment, stream counter, and final snapshot field sets (146-178); the disconnected terminal value (187); the stream-control operations attach, detach, stats, and final_snapshot (209-231); the TunerService public operations and private lease/state bookkeeping (256-363).
source_files.excluded_scope: The receiver_count and receiver_supports defaults with the fixed PX-Q3U4 layout (23-33), the default bodies of the power, disconnect, shutdown, and capture seams, the satellite-before-tune and terrestrial-settle defaults (37-40, 54-57), the remaining terminal values and read result (180-195), release_final, read, and terminal (232-253), and the ipc wire types. Receiver IDs became u16 identities separate from storage slots; frontend tune is one operation with an explicit kHz parameter; the settle decision became a backend-supplied duration.

source_files.moved_scope: The lifecycle algorithm at original lines 18-58 and 80-983: construction and shutdown on destruction, client and initial-system checks, lease lookup, lease and attachment ID allocation, acquire, release, lock polling, the tune sequence with power rollback and the post-lock settle arithmetic, stream start, attach with compensation, stop with final snapshot, stats, detach, both revoke forms, status, client cleanup, and shutdown.
source_files.excluded_scope: The px4_drv-referenced 340 ms terrestrial settle constant and its citation (11-14), which the product supplies through the backend seam; the PX4 wire request validation table valid_tune (59-78), whose per-request decision the product passes in the tune request; the fixed tune response payload construction (503-504).

wire.method: New independent implementation of the documented first wire subset; no PX4 wire source was copied or modified.
wire.scope: UDTV 1.0 envelope and bounded frame/header handling; typed HELLO request and ACQUIRE request/response. No typed HELLO response, later control opcodes, or full wire protocol.
